aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:873.title: Partner Activation Manager
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:873.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The Partnership Activation Manager will be responsible for managing and supporting sponsorship activations for Festival properties, managing designated AEG Presents partnerships, and coordinating key division events. Essential Functions Account Servicing – Manage day-to-day advance, maintenance and fulfillment of partnership agreements. This includes, but is not limited to: Fulfillment of all elements in accounts including promotions, print, onsite activations, signage, hospitality, etc. Develop new and exciting promotional concepts for partners to help provide maximum return on investment Participation in renewal process to ensure elements are enhanced or revised as needed Preparation of partnership recap for events and other properties at the end of the year/season in a timely manner Assist the Director, Partnership Activation with designated activation elements and organization. Administration – Maintain various databases and reports as assigned by Director and SVP. This includes, but is not limited to: Partner contact information Contractual ticket banks Partner checklists and tracking sheets Onsite activation production advance Attend sponsor/partner functions and events as needed. Required Qualifications BA/BS Degree (4-year) 4-6 years Related work experience Possess excellent verbal & written communication skills Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively. Proactive and have the ability to work independently without the need for supervision Problem-solving and adaptability in fast-paced environments. Excellent at relationship building and people skills Basic understanding of digital activation and data reporting. Ability to handle minor lifting and load/unload merchandise Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and CRM tools. Regular attendance and hours in conformance with the standards, which may be established by AEG from time to time, is essential to the successful performance of this position. Due to the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, the employee may be required to work varying schedules to reflect the business needs of the company including working game nights and event weekends. Payscale: $84,622.00 - $124,481.00 Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship. AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside their normal description. AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants,

campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:7802ff91-a3cc-.title: Sales Manager
campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:7802ff91-a3cc-.description: ABOUT CAMPFIRE Campfire is the AI-native ERP redefining how finance teams operate. We replace legacy systems like NetSuite, SAP, and Oracle with a unified platform for the general ledger, revenue automation, and close management - powered by our proprietary Large Accounting Model. We're backed by Accel, Ribbit Capital, Foundation Capital, and Y Combinator, and trusted by fast-growing companies like Decagon, Replit, and Klarity. With more than $100m in funding so far, we're scaling the team that closes and expands relationships with modern finance leaders. THE ROLE We're hiring a Sales Manager to lead a team of Account Executives - the people who take a qualified opportunity and turn it into a closed, thriving Campfire customer. You'll own quota attainment for your team, coach AEs through complex, consultative sales cycles into finance and accounting orgs, and instill the rigor and discipline of a high-performing sales floor. This is a player-coach leadership role for someone who loves the deal, knows how to develop closers, and wants to help build a repeatable, scalable sales motion from an early foundation. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives to consistently meet and exceed revenue targets. - Own your team's number: forecast accurately, manage the pipeline, and drive quota attainment quarter over quarter. - Coach AEs through full-cycle, consultative deals - discovery, business-case building, multithreading, negotiation, and close - selling to CFOs, VPs of Finance, and Controllers. - Run disciplined deal reviews and pipeline inspection, help reps navigate complex, multi-stakeholder evaluations that often displace incumbent ERPs. - Refine and document the sales playbook: qualification frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC), messaging, and repeatable close plans. - Partner with SDR Managers on pipeline quality and handoffs, and with Marketing, Product, and Solutions Consultants on what's needed to win. - Hire and onboard new AEs, and build a ramp program that gets them productive quickly. - Build the team from the ground up - source, interview, and hire AEs, and design a ramp program that gets new reps productive quickly - Maintain clean forecasting and CRM hygiene, and report on team performance to leadership. - Foster a culture of accountability, coaching, and winning - where reps are challenged and supported in equal measure. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 2+ years managing a quota-carrying AE team, with a consistent record of hitting and exceeding team targets. - A strong personal track record closing B2B SaaS deals before you moved into management - ideally mid-market or enterprise. - Track record of holding Account Executives accountable for self-sourced outbound prospecting in a full-cycle sales motion - not just managing our inbound-heavy pipeline. - Experience selling technical or finance-oriented products; familiarity with the office of the CFO, ERP, fintech, or accounting workflows is a big plus. - Command of a modern sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, or similar) and the ability to teach it. - Sharp forecasting instincts and comfort running data-driven pipeline reviews. - A genuine coaching orientation - you measure your success by your team's growth and results. - Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where the playbook is still being written. WHY CAMPFIRE - Own revenue outcomes at a Series B company in a category that's being rebuilt for the AI era. - Shape the sales motion and culture that will scale Campfire to its next stage. - Competitive salary and OTE, meaningful equity, and full benefits. - Work alongside exceptional operators and sell a product that's replacing software finance teams have been golden handcuffed by for decades.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:852.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Kitchen Assistant at Sur La Table, you play a key role in inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. With a passion for cooking, hospitality, and teamwork, the Kitchen Assistant supports the chefs to ensure smooth class operations and a #bestincenter experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. You’ll help bring culinary dreams to life by supporting our chefs, engaging with guests, and ensuring a clean, well-organized kitchen environment. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture in both the kitchen and retail sales floor. Sales & Business Performance · Assist chefs with class execution that drives repeat visits and positive customer feedback · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time · Ability to move about the store directing class participants while selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor · The capability to accurately perceive and differentiate variations in intensity or quality of flavors or odors, or to identify specific tastes or scents using the tongue or nose. · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel and crouch to demonstrate, retrieve and/or replenish merchandise and/or cooking equipment. · Ability to use hands to seize, hold, grasp, turn, or otherwise to chop, whisk, slice, stir, juice and/or demonstrate other techniques. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with a diverse range of stakeholders. Excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy, quality, and compliance. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c6d08e1f-6c06-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Turkey. This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows. You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations. The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness. You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates. The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core. You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices. Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios. Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles. Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks. Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities. Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios. Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis. Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria. Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines. Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards. Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. Requirements Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows. Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns. Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools. Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools. Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling. Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements. SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage. Experience with distributed systems is a plus. Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial. pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:d0544171-c8d5-43e.title: Founding Engineer - Elo
pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:d0544171-c8d5-43e.description: Elo is the ad-network for consumer AI applications. We’ve gone from 0 to XXM users in our publisher network in 45 days of inception. Background With AI becoming the primary surface of interaction for internet users, it is inevitable that digital advertising will happen within AI experiences (including but not limited to chat). Elo is aggregating supply across consumer AI apps to help them monetize their users via ads and help advertisers reach the right audience at the right moment. We’re backed by top funds like PearVC https://pear.vc/ and Audacious Ventures https://audacious.co/ who’ve invested in billion dollar companies like Doordash and WorkOS https://workos.com/. We also have advisors from mobile ad-tech and large consumer AI companies helping us in our mission. Founder is a published researcher and has previously built AI infrastructure at Google. Progress We’ve already solved the hardest cold start problem with ad networks: onboarding both advertisers and publishers. Now, we need to build and improve the core infrastructure to serve the most contextually relevant ads at the right moment. Role Founding engineer who’ll help us design the engine for ad delivery inside AI experiences and supporting infrastructure. The role guarantees high equity and competitive compensation What you’ll build We’re already processing millions of requests per minute which is set to increase dramatically over the next few months. You’ll work on: 1. Ad decisioning pipeline: candidate retrieval, scoring, filtering, and final ranking under strict latency SLAs 2. Publisher SDK: lightweight integration that AI app developers embed in hours, not days 3. Delivery infrastructure: pacing, frequency capping, budget management, and campaign throttling 4. Observability stack: real-time dashboards for auction win rates, fill rates, revenue, and latency percentiles What we’re looking for We look for evidence of technical excellence. If you’ve built any of the following, we’d love to chat: 1. Your own AI agent harness or multi-agent workflow for complex tasks 2. Low latency network infrastructure and data pipelines serving millions of requests per second 3. Scalable and self-healing infrastructure with 1000s of compute workers spinning up and down with variable demand 4. High frequency trading systems Or anything that you believe reflects high calibre of engineering design and low-level systems understanding. You’re a good fit if you: 1. Care about your craft and operate ethically 2. Take extreme ownership of outcomes 3. Like to operate independently 4. Ship extremely fast and effectively use AI to accelerate your impact 5. Want to operate in a fun and social work environment Apply and you’ll hear back in less than a day.

We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms. Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech? Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI. By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms. Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation. What You’ll Need - Native or near-native fluency in Azerbaijani - Based in: Azerbaijan, Remote - English proficiency - Comfortable with digital tools - Detail-oriented and curious Why Join Us? 🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow 🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI 🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community About our projects: Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
